note: Composition manifest for DRAFT TAPPs authored in this repository. Same shape as the TAPP library's composed_tapps.json, kept separate so an unreviewed draft never enters the library's own record of what exists. module_composition consults the library manifest first and falls back to this file, so a draft composes module $defs by $ref exactly as a released TAPP does.

composed.note: DRAFT - not a Phase 0 reviewed TAPP. Seeded from the ADA VNMIR detail schema; source lives in the geochemBuildingBlocks repo (draftTAPPs/), not this library. Aggregation deliberately not composed: VNMIR reports per-measurement spectra, not values aggregated from multiple analyses - same module set as Lab-XCT.

DRAFT - not a Phase 0 reviewed TAPP. Seeded from the ADA QRIS detail schema; source lives in the geochemBuildingBlocks repo (draftTAPPs/), not this library. Same module set as Lab-XCT and the VNMIR draft. Zero mode-flag columns: its ada:componentTypes (Raw / Calibrated / CalibrationFile) are pipeline stages of one acquisition, not acquisition modes.

DRAFT - not a Phase 0 reviewed TAPP. Seeded from the ADA XRD detail schema; source lives in the geochemBuildingBlocks repo (draftTAPPs/), not this library. Same module set as Lab-XCT and the VNMIR draft. Zero mode-flag columns: it delivers a single technique componentType (XRDTabular), so there is no mode axis to flag.

DRAFT - not a Phase 0 reviewed TAPP, and CORE-ONLY: the native technique layer is EMPTY. RAMAN has no ADA detail schema and no technique property anywhere in its records, so there was nothing to seed a native layer from and none was invented. This registers the procedure skeleton - identity, laboratory, instrument, samples, session, reported variables - and needs Phase 0 seed papers before it says anything RAMAN-specific. Source lives in the geochemBuildingBlocks repo (draftTAPPs/), not this library.
